title: calonema sanguineum
intro: Calonema sanguineum, commonly known as Dendrobium sanguineum, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, which include offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Calonema sanguineum include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Calonema sanguineum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
